Name: Full Access
Description: Bypasses all permission checks; granted automatically to organisation owners.

Name: View Role Management
Description: Access the Roles & permissions screen to see which roles exist and what permissions they carry.

Name: Manage Roles and Permissions

Name: View all subscriptions

Description: End an existing plan or add-on so it stops renewing and the feature is no longer available.

Name: View organisation details
Description: See the organisation’s name, branding, and high-level settings (e.g. enterprise status) without editing.

Name: Request enterprise access
Description: Submit or trigger a request for enterprise-level features or terms for the organisation.

Name: Update organisation details
Description: Change the organisation’s name, branding, or other settings stored at org level.

Name: View organisation documents
Description: Access documents or files stored under the organisation (e.g. contracts, certificates).

Name: Create organisation documents
Description: Upload or create new documents that belong to the organisation.

Name: View all team members
Description: List everyone in the organisation’s team, their roles, and invite status.

Name: Remove team members
Description: Remove a user from the organisation so they lose access to the portal and APIs for this org.

Name: Invite team members
Description: Send email invitations so new users can join the organisation’s team.

Name: Update team member
Description: Change a team member’s assigned role(s), permission overrides, or department.

Name: View departments
Description: List the organisation’s departments used when assigning team members.

Name: Manage departments
Description: Create, edit, or remove organisation departments.

Name: Manage notification groups
Description: Define and edit groups that control who receives which system or product notifications.

Name: View in-app notifications
Description: Use the notifications bell and drawer in the portal to read and dismiss in-app alerts.

Name: View all ID verification requests
Description: List every ID verification request (e.g. link sent to a candidate) and their status.

Name: View ID verification request details
Description: Open one request to see expiry, link, and whether it was completed or withdrawn.

Name: View all screening results
Description: List all risk screening cases and their outcomes (e.g. sanctions, PEP, adverse media).

Name: View screening result
Description: Open one screening case to see hits, sources, and risk flags in detail.

Name: Submit screening request
Description: Run a new screening (e.g. sanctions, PEP, adverse media) for a person or company.

Name: View screening dashboard
Description: Access the screening overview (counts, recent cases, quick actions).

Name: View all people
Description: List people that have been screened or are linked to screening cases.

Name: View person details
Description: Open one person record to see name, identifiers, and linked screening results.

Name: Edit person
Description: Change a person’s name, DOB, or other details in the screening database.

Name: Delete person
Description: Remove a person record from the screening area (e.g. for data minimisation).

Name: Create person
Description: Add a new person to the screening database so they can be screened.

Name: View all companies
Description: List companies that have been screened or are linked to screening cases.

Name: View company details
Description: Open one company record to see name, registration, and linked screening results.

Name: Create company
Description: Add a new company to the screening database so it can be screened.

Name: Edit company
Description: Change a company’s name, registration number, or other details.

Name: Delete company
Description: Remove a company record from the screening area.

Name: Business discovery
Description: Search external sources to discover and match companies before or after screening.

Name: Archive screening case
Description: Archive or unarchive a screening case so it is hidden from or restored to active lists.

Name: Create screening case
Description: Start a new screening case and attach people or companies to run checks.

Name: Create screening template
Description: Define a reusable set of screening checks (e.g. sanctions + PEP) to run on cases.

Name: Update screening template
Description: Change the checks or settings of an existing screening template.

Name: Archive screening template
Description: Archive a template so it can no longer be applied to new cases.

Name: Run screening search
Description: Execute or re-run searches (e.g. sanctions, PEP) within a screening case.

Name: Contact screening candidate
Description: Send messages or requests to a candidate linked to a screening case.

Name: Request screening verification
Description: Request that a candidate provide or confirm information for the screening case.

Name: View dashboard
Description: Access the main portal dashboard (stats, quick actions, recent activity).

Name: View operations report
Description: View organisation operations metrics (signed applications, ID verification outcomes, daily blockers) and export CSV for invoice checks.

Name: View verification request workflow
Description: See the Workflow timeline on a verification request (ops actions such as waiting on TRN or re-upload).

Name: View all profiles
Description: Access the profiles list and search or filter people who have completed verifications.

Name: View profile details
Description: Open a profile page; which tabs and evidence you see still depend on separate tab and evidence permissions.

Name: View profile Identity tab
Description: See the Identity tab on a profile: document type, status, and result summary only (no ID images unless you also have view identity evidence).

Name: View profile Address tab
Description: See the Address tab: verified address and result summary only (no document or photo files unless you also have view address evidence).

Name: View profile References tab
Description: See the References tab: character or employer references and their status or response.

Name: View profile Employment tab
Description: See the Employment tab: employment history and verification outcomes.

Name: View profile Qualifications tab
Description: See the Qualifications tab: qualification and credential verification outcomes (degrees, diplomas, certifications).

Name: View profile Income tab
Description: See the Income tab: income verification results (e.g. employer, amount, date range).

Name: Export income evidence profile
Description: Download JSON, CSV, or PDF exports of the income evidence v2 profile when the full report is visible.

Name: View profile Criminal Records tab
Description: See the Criminal Records tab: background check results and any disclosures.

Name: View profile Tenancy tab
Description: See the Tenancy history tab: past tenancies and landlord references.

Name: View profile Screening tab
Description: See the Screening tab: risk screening cases and results linked to this profile.

Name: Manage profile screening monitoring
Description: Configure recurring background screening monitoring on a profile.

Name: Manage company screening monitoring
Description: Configure recurring background screening monitoring on a company screening result.

Name: View profile Documents tab
Description: See documents this person has signed or is listed on as a signing party, with status and view link when complete.

Name: View identity evidence
Description: View or request watermarked ID document images and selfie/media on a profile; needed in addition to the Identity tab to see actual ID photos.

Name: View address evidence
Description: View address proof documents and residence photos on a profile; needed in addition to the Address tab to open or download those files.

Name: Manage table filters
Description: Save, edit, and delete saved filters on the profiles table (e.g. “Cleared only”, “Pending”) for yourself or your team.

Name: Extend verification request
Description: Give a candidate more time to complete a verification by extending the request expiry.

Name: Withdraw verification request
Description: Cancel an active request so the link no longer works and the candidate cannot submit.

Name: Create verification request template
Description: Define a reusable template (e.g. which checks to request) so you can send the same type of request repeatedly.

Name: Update verification request template
Description: Change the checks or settings of an existing verification request template.

Name: Delete verification request template
Description: Remove a template so it can no longer be used to create new requests.

Name: Create organisation
Description: Create a new organisation so a new team or brand can use the portal under its own billing and settings.

Name: Upload organisation logo
Description: Upload or replace the logo shown in the portal and on shared links for this organisation.

Name: Delete organisation logo
Description: Remove the organisation logo so the default or no logo is shown.

Name: View billing
Description: Access the billing area to see plans, usage, payment methods, and credit balance.

Name: Add payment method
Description: Add a new card or payment method for the organisation’s billing.

Description: Choose which payment method is used by default for charges and renewals.

Name: Delete payment method
Description: Remove a saved payment method so it can no longer be charged.

Name: Purchase credit bundle
Description: Buy a pack of credits (e.g. for verifications or screening) when using pay-as-you-go.

Name: Switch billing mode
Description: Change the organisation between subscription billing and pay-as-you-go (or vice versa).

Name: View all documents
Description: List all documents (e.g. contracts, forms) that the organisation has created or received for signing.

Name: Create document
Description: Create a new document (upload or from template) so it can be sent for signing.

Name: View document
Description: Open a single document to read its contents and see signing status.

Name: Download document
Description: Download a copy of a document file (e.g. PDF) to your device.

Name: Reuse document
Description: Use an existing document as the basis for a new one (e.g. same content, new signers).

Name: Cancel document
Description: Cancel a document so signers can no longer sign and it is marked cancelled.

Name: Remind document signers
Description: Send a reminder email to signers who have not yet signed.

Name: Create template from document
Description: Save a completed or draft document as a reusable template for future sends.

Name: Update document
Description: Edit a document’s content or settings before or after sending.

Name: Send document
Description: Send a document to signers so they receive the signing link and can complete it.

Name: Delete document
Description: Permanently remove a document from the organisation’s document list.

Name: Add document to envelope
Description: Add one or more documents to an envelope so they can be sent together for signing.

Name: Create envelope
Description: Create a new envelope to group documents and send them in one signing flow.

Name: View all document templates
Description: List all saved document templates the organisation can use to create new documents.

Name: Create document template
Description: Create a new template (e.g. standard contract) so the team can send documents from it repeatedly.

Name: Duplicate document template
Description: Copy an existing template to create a variant or backup.

Name: Delete document template
Description: Remove a template so it can no longer be used to create documents.

Name: Use document template
Description: Start a new document from a template (pre-filled content and fields).

Name: Publish document template version
Description: Publish staged template changes so they become the live version used for new documents and signing.

Name: Restore document template version
Description: Restore a previous template version as the new pending version (for review and re-publish).

Name: Publish document version
Description: Publish staged document changes so they become the live version used when sending for signing.

Name: Restore document version
Description: Restore a previous document version as the new pending version (for review and re-publish).

Name: View all envelopes
Description: List all envelopes (groups of documents sent together) and their status.

Name: View envelope
Description: Open one envelope to see its documents and signing progress.

Name: Send envelope
Description: Send an envelope to signers so they receive links to sign all documents in it.

Name: Cancel envelope
Description: Cancel an envelope so no further signing can occur.

Name: Remove document from envelope
Description: Remove a document from an envelope before sending (or to correct the set).

Name: Download envelope documents
Description: Download the documents contained in an envelope as files.

Name: View all envelope templates
Description: List all saved envelope templates (document sets + signer roles) the organisation can reuse.

Name: Create envelope template
Description: Create a new envelope template so the team can send the same document set repeatedly.

Name: Duplicate envelope template
Description: Copy an existing envelope template to create a variant.

Name: Delete envelope template
Description: Remove an envelope template so it can no longer be used.

Name: Update envelope template
Description: Edit an envelope template’s documents or signer configuration.

Name: Use envelope template
Description: Create a new envelope from a template (pre-filled document set and roles).

Name: View preferences
Description: Access the preferences screen to see language, currency, and display options (read-only without update permission).

Name: Update preferences
Description: Change your language, currency, date format, or other personal display preferences.

Name: View account settings
Description: Access the account screen to see your email, name, and security-related settings.

Name: View Security settings
Description: Access Security for password, MFA, and trusted devices.

Name: Manage security credentials
Description: Change password, configure SMS MFA and authenticator apps.

Name: Request email change

Name: Verify reference number

Name: View support
Description: Access the help and support area (docs, contact options); not used for access control as support is available to all.

Name: Update webhook endpoint

Name: Update landing page
Description: Change the URL or page where candidates are sent to start a verification (e.g. your own hosted flow).

Name: Add integration domain
Description: Allow another domain (e.g. your app’s origin) to use the organisation’s integrations or embed verification.

Name: Remove integration domain
Description: Revoke a previously allowed domain so it can no longer use the organisation’s integrations.

Name: Access onboarding workspace

Name: View all onboarding pages
Description: List all onboarding or lead-capture pages the organisation has created.

Name: Create onboarding page

Name: Delete onboarding page
Description: Permanently remove an onboarding page and (depending on config) its collected data.

Name: Update onboarding page
Description: Edit an onboarding page’s fields, layout, or settings.

Name: Publish onboarding page
Description: Publish staged onboarding page changes so the public link shows the updated content.

Name: Restore onboarding page version
Description: Restore a previously published version into staging for review and re-publish.

Name: Send onboarding invitations
Description: Send invite links or emails so candidates can access and complete an onboarding page.

Name: View onboarding entries
Description: See the list of submissions or entries (who completed the page and when).

Name: View onboarding event logs
Description: See the audit trail of events for an onboarding page (e.g. opened, submitted, bounced).

Name: Manage onboarding custom fields
Description: Add, edit, or remove custom fields on an onboarding page so you collect the data you need.

Name: View webhook configs

Name: Manage webhook configs

Name: View webhook event logs

Name: Rerun webhook events

Name: View all verification links

Name: Create verification link
Description: Generate a new verification link to share with a candidate (e.g. embed in your app or email).

Name: Update verification link
Description: Edit a verification link’s expiry, type, or other settings.

Name: Delete verification link
Description: Revoke or delete a verification link so it can no longer be used.

Name: Add company
Description: Add a company to the screening company list so it can be screened or linked to cases.

Name: Create company screening result
Description: Record or create a screening result (e.g. manual outcome) for a company.

Name: Search companies
Description: Search the screening company list by name, registration, or other criteria.

Name: Initiate sanctions search
Description: Run a sanctions list check on a company to see if it appears on restricted lists.

Name: Initiate reputation search
Description: Run a reputation or adverse media search on a company.

Name: Initiate legal search
Description: Run a legal or court-record search on a company.

Name: Request financial verification
Description: Request that financial or credit information be verified for a company.

Name: Request address verification
Description: Request that the company’s address be verified (e.g. proof of business address).

Name: View all digital IDs

Name: Export digital ID audit
